text: Si lepte ɗen waɗɗiike ɗe tabitii e maɓɓe sabu deppitagol maɓɓe e keeferaaku maɓɓe e geddi maɓɓe ɗin, heddike yimɓe bonɓe ɓen, Men yaltinanoya ɓe tuma ɓadagol Darngal ngal maande jeyaande e maandeeji maggal mawɗi ɗin, ɗum le ko daabewa ka leydi himba haalana ɓe ko faamata wonndema yimɓe ɓen ɓe goonginaa Aayeeje Amen jippinaaɗe ɗen e dow Annabaaɓe Amen ɓen.
